outcome: Every job posting reaches the owner's Discord DMs (and the resume pipeline) at most once, identified by its ATS posting id; and everything that runs (scraper, process_stream, the autojob resume generator, the health probe) is held to a checked contract by bin/check.sh; and the employer's ATS is a source (board registry, anonymous 15-minute poller, extraction by ATS id), each Greenhouse posting is screened (closed, duplicate req, agency, ghost) before it spends a generation slot, and what happened after a resume was sent is recorded per lane, variant and channel.
requirements: a posting's identity is its ATS job id (Greenhouse gh_jid, Lever uuid), else its normalized URL; never mutable listing fields
the ledger changes only through Ledger.record; a known posting is never re-recorded
the ledger is append-only: existing rows are never rewritten or removed
parity: on real scrape history, every notification the goal drops relative to legacy is a repeat of an already-notified posting or a row with no URL
every Greenhouse posting handed to resume generation ends with exactly one outcome (sent, dm_failed, gen_failed, timeout) in the append-only resume log
a resume is never DM'd twice for the same posting key: ResumeLog.reserve refuses a seen key before any DM is scheduled
scrape selection is a pure goal (select-listings): dedupe by objectID, Greenhouse/Lever only, VIEW_CAP=100, blocked companies; no I/O
the scrape CSV header and row mapping have one home (values/scrape_csv.py), and a CSV written by the scraper ingests through ingest-listings
the process_stream/autojob boundary (job-urls lines, stdout markers) is checked from both sides
health.sh, linkedin_lookup and Discord routing are tested offline
the skills section may list any skill; skills outside skills_inventory.txt are reported as 'SKILLS_GUARD: not in inventory', not dropped; items that are not skill names by format are dropped
the generated skills section is 3 to 5 lines of at most 95 characters with no dashes or numbers, and the largest allowed section fits on one page
per job only the headline and Technical Skills change; Projects, Certifications and Education never do
the resume headline and PDF name use the role title only: no clearance, polygraph, work-arrangement, contract, location or req-id text (RCA 0002)
every invariant enforced by a test is an adopted rule whose test fails on a planted violation (rules/enforced_by.json, integrity/gates/rule_plants.py)
linkedin_cache.json is owned by the linkedin_cache noun and written only by the find-linkedin goal; it holds hits only
search filters are data in filters/active.json with every earlier set archived and revertible in one copy; the archived baseline equals the filters at tag filters-baseline-2026-10-06
a hiring.cafe page without search data is retried and a filter that still fails is reported, never counted as zero jobs
a scrape keeps its browser temp files in one folder of its own and deletes it when it ends; a folder left by a killed run is deleted by a later run (adr:0012)

autojob keeps each Puppeteer profile in a folder of its own that the snap Chromium writes to and deletes it when the browser closes or the process exits; a folder left by a killed run is deleted by a later launch (adr:0013)
job-urls lines are url<TAB>title<TAB>company; the scraped company wins when non-empty
the deterministic resume audit runs nightly and the resume mobs never write tracked files (R-mobs-untrusted-output)
the morning loot DM is sent at most once per night (R-loot-once-per-night)
a posting URL parses to (ats, tenant, job_id) for Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Workday in values/ats.py; posting_key keys all six by ATS id on the ATS's own host
autojob reads a posting that carries a Greenhouse id from the boards API whatever the host; a 404 is a dead posting; token failure or title divergence falls back to the page (R-route-by-ats-id)
ats_registry.jsonl is owned by the AtsRegistry noun; a board is added only after its API answered 200, and a posting is emitted at most once (R-registry-verified-once)
requests to ATS APIs carry one fixed header set with no owner identity (R-ats-requests-anonymous)
the ATS poller writes at most 8 rows per run and 40 per UTC day, only lane-matched, US, fresh postings not already in the ledger (R-poll-caps)

a poller row carries the posting's technology names (values/tech_terms) and the company link from linkedin_lookup.enrich, falling back to the posting's non-ATS host; no lookup starts after 760 s into a run, and a dry run does none
a Greenhouse posting is screened before generation: closed, duplicate req and agency postings get no resume and no resume_log entry; the rest run in ghost-score order (R-req-once)
outcome_log.jsonl is owned by the OutcomeLog noun; an event is recorded only for a delivered posting, once per event until retracted (R-outcome-delivered-only)
